views.name: mv_topic_stats
views.definition:
SELECT t.topic_name,
    t.status AS topic_status,
    t.retention_days,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS pending,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'claimed'::text) AS claimed,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'delivered'::text) AS delivered,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'dead'::text) AS dead,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM dead_letter_message d
          WHERE d.original_topic_id = t.topic_id AND d.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS dlq_pending,
    min(m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS oldest_pending,
    max(m.created_at) AS last_message_at
   FROM topic t
     LEFT JOIN message m ON m.topic_id = t.topic_id
  GROUP BY t.topic_id, t.topic_name, t.status, t.retention_days;

views.name: v_audit_recent
views.definition:
SELECT al.log_id,
    COALESCE(u.username, 'system'::character varying) AS username,
    a.app_name,
    t.topic_name,
    al.event_type,
    al.status,
    al.details,
    al.event_timestamp
   FROM audit_log al
     LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = al.user_id
     LEFT JOIN application a ON a.app_id = al.app_id
     LEFT JOIN topic t ON t.topic_id = al.topic_id
  WHERE al.event_timestamp >= (now() - '24:00:00'::interval);

views.name: v_consumer_lag
views.definition:
SELECT t.topic_name,
    cg.group_name,
    pt.partition_number,
    go.committed_offset,
    pt.next_offset AS head_offset,
    pt.next_offset - go.committed_offset AS lag_messages,
    go.updated_at AS last_commit_at
   FROM group_offset go
     JOIN partition pt ON pt.partition_id = go.partition_id
     JOIN topic t ON t.topic_id = pt.topic_id
     JOIN consumer_group cg ON cg.group_id = go.group_id
  ORDER BY t.topic_name, cg.group_name, pt.partition_number;

views.name: v_throughput_by_minute
views.definition:
SELECT topic_name,
    minute_ts,
    messages,
    sum(messages) OVER (PARTITION BY topic_name ORDER BY minute_ts) AS cumulative_messages
   FROM ( SELECT t.topic_name,
            date_trunc('minute'::text, m.created_at) AS minute_ts,
            count(*) AS messages
           FROM message m
             JOIN topic t ON t.topic_id = m.topic_id
          WHERE m.created_at >= (now() - '02:00:00'::interval)
          GROUP BY t.topic_name, (date_trunc('minute'::text, m.created_at))) per_minute;

views.name: v_topic_stats
views.definition:
SELECT t.topic_name,
    t.status AS topic_status,
    t.retention_days,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS pending,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'claimed'::text) AS claimed,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'delivered'::text) AS delivered,
    count(m.msg_offset) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'dead'::text) AS dead,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM dead_letter_message d
          WHERE d.original_topic_id = t.topic_id AND d.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS dlq_pending,
    min(m.created_at) FILTER (WHERE m.status::text = 'pending'::text) AS oldest_pending,
    max(m.created_at) AS last_message_at
   FROM topic t
     LEFT JOIN message m ON m.topic_id = t.topic_id
  GROUP BY t.topic_id, t.topic_name, t.status, t.retention_days;

views.name: mv_monthly_sales
views.definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, ordered_at::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    category,
    sum(quantity) AS units,
    sum(line_total) AS sales
   FROM reporting.v_sales_lines
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, ordered_at::timestamp with time zone)::date), category;

views.name: v_run_progress
views.definition:
SELECT r.run_id,
    t.code,
    t.version,
    r.status AS preparation_status,
    r.created_at,
    r.prepared_at,
    count(q.request_id) AS expected,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.state = 'queued'::text) AS queued,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.state = 'processing'::text) AS processing,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.state = 'completed'::text) AS completed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.state = 'failed'::text) AS failed,
    max(q.completed_at) AS last_completion
   FROM reporting.report_run r
     JOIN reporting.template_version t USING (template_id)
     LEFT JOIN reporting.report_request q USING (run_id)
  GROUP BY r.run_id, t.code, t.version;

views.name: v_sales_lines
views.definition:
SELECT c.customer_id,
    c.customer_ref,
    c.full_name,
    c.region,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_ref,
    o.ordered_at,
    i.line_number,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    i.quantity,
    i.unit_price,
    (i.quantity::numeric * i.unit_price)::numeric(20,2) AS line_total
   FROM reporting.customer c
     JOIN reporting.sales_order o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
     JOIN reporting.order_item i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
     JOIN reporting.product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'::text;
